title: Newlin Grist Mill

services.name: Educational Programs
services.desc: Education at Newlin Grist Mill: A History and Nature Preserve. Our comprehensive educational program fully leverages the site’s unique blend of history, traditional trades, and natural resources. We offer a wide variety of interdisciplinary, hands-on tours, demonstrations, and programs adaptable to different curricula and age groups (preschool through high school and beyond). Building upon Newlin’s existing resources-including hearth cooking, blacksmithing, archaeology, and traditional woodworking programs-the curriculum will emphasize experiential learning while demonstrating the continued relevance of traditional knowledge, craftsmanship, and problem-solving skills. Choose from our menu

services.name: Blacksmithing Classes
services.desc: Have you wondered what it’s like to work at the forge? These classes offer the opportunity to learn the basics in a historic setting using traditional techniques. Perfect for both beginners who just want to try or those looking for foundational techniques to build their skills. Instructors are Bo Palmatary and Andy Williams. Participants in the Beginning I class will learn shop safety, fire management, tools and equipment, hammer control, tapering, pointing, bending, scrolling, and twisting. Each participant will learn these basic skills while completing three projects. Fee covers all tools and materials. Course consists of one 6-hour session, 10am-4pm. Participants in Beginning II class

services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: Newlin Grist Mill is the perfect site for your next special event. Whether you are looking for a space for birthday or graduation parties, reunions, company picnics, or weddings, Newlin Grist Mill provides a unique setting for a wide variety of occasions. Please note that alcohol is not permitted anywhere on the property. Bands, DJs, and amplified music are also prohibited. For an intimate and rustic indoor event, our newly renovated log cabin provides a perfect location with a fireplace, bathroom facilities, and a kitchen area. The rental includes the use of seven 8-ft. tables and 50 chairs inside the cabin. Also included in the rental is the use of picnic tables outside of the cabin

services.name: Tasting
services.desc: Explore history through your taste-buds! Participants will enjoy a five-course dinner with accompanying drinks while learning about the culinary traditions of the past. This is a fundraising event to support the Trimble Kitchen project at Newlin Grist
